title: The Human Ear and Hearing Health
summary: How the outer, middle and inner ear turn pressure waves into nerve signals, and how to protect your hearing.
objectives: I can describe the parts of the ear and what each does.
I can explain how the ear converts sound into electrical signals.
I can explain how loud sounds damage hearing and how to prevent it.
misconceptions: We hear with our eardrums alone.
Only very painful sounds damage hearing.
